description: Simple line-drawing tracing practice on Rokid glasses: 12 original pictures with 83 hand-authored per-stroke coordinate data (current stroke brightest green), spoken stroke tips, draw the whole picture on real notebook paper, then a photo check for three coarse items only (missing strokes, the most off proportion, unclosed shapes), learner override, a name-only review quiz and cross-session progress.
name: Trace Sketch
